vars.label: Tax-exempt organizations (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Organizations the IRS recognizes as exempt from federal income tax whose headquarters address is in the municipio: charities, social welfare groups, unions, business leagues, clubs and the like. Many Puerto Rico nonprofits are registered only under Puerto Rico law and are not in this list.

vars.label: 501(c)(3) charities (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Of those, the organizations exempt under section 501(c)(3): charities, schools, churches that applied, and other public-benefit groups to which gifts are deductible.

vars.label: Nonprofits: arts, culture and humanities (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with A: arts, culture and humanities.

vars.label: Nonprofits: education (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with B: education.

vars.label: Nonprofits: environment and animals (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with C, D: environment and animals.

vars.label: Nonprofits: health (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with E, F, G, H: health.

vars.label: Nonprofits: human services (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P: human services.

vars.label: Nonprofits: international and foreign affairs (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with Q: international and foreign affairs.

vars.label: Nonprofits: public and societal benefit (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with R, S, T, U, V, W: public and societal benefit.

vars.label: Nonprofits: religion-related (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with X: religion-related.

vars.label: Nonprofits: mutual and membership benefit (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with Y: mutual and membership benefit.

vars.label: Nonprofits: unclassified or no NTEE code (IRS)
vars.ref: IRS EO BMF, Puerto Rico file of 2026-11-09
vars.definition: Tax-exempt organizations whose NTEE code (the activity code the IRS gives) starts with Z, or that have no code: unclassified or no NTEE code.

irs_eo_bmf.name: IRS — Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract (EO BMF), Puerto Rico
irs_eo_bmf.license: US federal government work (public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105); the IRS page states no licence
irs_eo_bmf.note: Every organization the IRS recognizes as tax-exempt with a Puerto Rico address. The observatory publishes counts for each municipio, never a name, EIN or address.

census_zcta_county.name: US Census Bureau — 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file
census_zcta_county.note: Places an organization in the municipio holding most of the land of its ZIP code when its city is not a municipio's name.

notes.note: An organization is counted where its headquarters address is, which may not be where it works. Puerto Rico's value counts every organization in the file, including those no municipio could be given.
